shell.newhere.title: I'm new…
shell.newhere.offer: New to {app}? Take a three-minute tour of the apps, the settings and where to get help.
shell.newhere.welcome.p: This tour takes about three minutes. It shows you around {app} and the rest of the family, then points out where to change things and where to get help.
shell.newhere.welcome.apps: The eight apps, and which one fits your work
shell.newhere.welcome.settings: Settings you may want to change on day one
shell.newhere.welcome.help: Help, lessons, tutorials and who to ask
shell.newhere.welcome.skip: You can leave at any time. Find it again under Help › I'm new….
shell.newhere.task.markup: Mark up and review PDFs and drawings
shell.newhere.apps.p: Each app does one kind of work, and they share the same shell, files and Library. Start with the one that fits your work.
shell.newhere.apps.note: Opening an app uses a new tab, so your work here stays as it is.
shell.newhere.app.cadcraft: 2D drafting from the command line, with DWG and DXF.
shell.newhere.app.bimcraft: Open, check, edit and review building models.
shell.newhere.app.modelcraft: 3D modeling for objects, scenes and printing.
shell.newhere.app.markupcraft: Mark up, measure and review PDFs and drawings.
shell.newhere.settings.p: Settings keep your choices on this computer. A few that new people often change:
shell.newhere.settings.layout.what: How the tools and panels are arranged. You can change it again later, for every app or one.
shell.newhere.settings.tours: Start each app's first-time tour by itself
shell.newhere.settings.l1: The {app} tab: options for this app only
shell.newhere.settings.l3: Light or dark look, icon style and text size
shell.newhere.settings.l4: Mouse, pen, keyboard and other input devices
shell.newhere.settings.none: Settings opens from the gear in the bar at the top.
shell.newhere.help.p: There are several places to learn and to ask. Press Show me to open one.
shell.newhere.help.panel.what: Topics for this app, searchable. Press {key} any time. It opens beside your work.
shell.newhere.help.find.what: Search commands, settings and help in one box.
shell.newhere.help.lessons.what: Step-by-step lessons in the app, with a mentor if you want one.
shell.newhere.help.tutorials.what: Walkthroughs with pictures for each app.
shell.newhere.help.support.what: Ask a person, or report a problem.
shell.newhere.help.news.what: What is new in each release.
shell.newhere.help.about.what: Version, edition and Report a problem with screenshots.
shell.newhere.done.p: That is the tour. Nothing was changed except what you chose.
shell.newhere.done.again: Help › I'm new… runs this tour again
